spanish: Y lo restante desde la minjá a Aarón y a sus hijos; santidad de santidades desde ofrendas de fuego de Jehová.

findings.issue: H4503 is a common noun (definite feminine singular); minjá leaves the lemma untranslated instead of Spanish.

notes: Remaining tokens match: remainder from the offering, to Aarón and his sons, holiness of holies, from fire-offerings of Jehová.
